findings.description: The inline policy grants wildcard actions (ec2:*, s3:*, lambda:*, cloudwatch:*) on all resources ("Resource": "*"), violating least privilege and allowing this IAM user to perform virtually any action across these services, including privilege escalation and data exfiltration.
A long-lived IAM access key/secret is created for the user rather than relying on temporary credentials or role assumption, increasing the risk of credential leakage and misuse if exposed.

findings.issue_category: human user with programmatic excess privileges
findings.description: An IAM user is created with force_destroy enabled and is attached (via aws_iam_user_policy.userpolicy) to an overly broad policy, combining a permanent identity with excessive permissions and no scoping conditions.
